arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى... فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ.
transliteration: Inna lillaahi maa akhath, wa lahu maa a'taa, wa kullu shay'in 'indahu bi'ajalin musammaa... faltasbir waltahtasib.
translation: Surely, Allah takes what is His, and what He gives is His, and to all things He has appointed a time... so have patience and be rewarded.

arabic: أَعْظَمَ اللهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ.
transliteration: A'thamallaahu ajrak, wa ahsana 'azaa'ak, wa ghafara limayyitik.
translation: May Allah magnify your reward, and make perfect your bereavement, and forgive your departed.
